questions.question: What lesson did the wilderness and the manna teach Israel?
options: That the LORD would always supply more than enough food
That man does not live by bread alone, but by every word of God
That bread from heaven was far sweeter than all the food of Egypt
That obedience brings rain and disobedience brings famine
questions.answer: That man does not live by bread alone, but by every word of God

questions.question: What did Moses warn would happen when Israel became prosperous?
Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell during forty years.
The wilderness taught that man does not live by _____ alone.
Moses warned them to beware, lest they _____ the LORD when they were full and prosperous.
